statements.statement: The claim is for ambulatory cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271)
The service was performed to correlate the patient's recurrent palpitations and brief neurological deficits with underlying arrhythmias
The patient has a documented history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has documented supraventricular tachycardia
The diagnosis codes are G45.9 and I47.1
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that care may be covered by another payer in accordance with coordination of benefits protocols
